name: syncLISData
shortDescription: Synchronizes lab results and other data with an external Laboratory Information System (LIS).
description:
Overview

Integrates with an external Laboratory Information System (LIS) to send test orders and receive structured lab results, updating patient MedicalRecords.

Intended use

Invoked as a scheduled job for periodic data exchange or as an event handler when new lab results are available from LIS. It processes data from the LIS and updates internal records.

Logic

  1. Connect to the LISSystem external service using ctx.service('LISSystem').
  2. Retrieve new lab results or send pending test orders via the LIS API.
  3. Parse the incoming lab results and map them to appropriate MedicalRecord attributes.
  4. Create or update MedicalRecord entries for the relevant Patients with recordType='lab_result' using ctx.data.create or ctx.data.update.
  5. Audit-log the LIS synchronization process and any data updates using ctx.audit.log.

Entities

  • MedicalRecord
  • Patient

External Services

  • LISSystem
